BUYER FAQ

Important questions before ordering.

Can you supply right-hand-drive electric trucks?

Yes. The catalogue includes right-hand-drive variants such as TE9Y, TZ4Y and TZ5Y. Availability and destination-market compliance are confirmed case by case.

Are European charging interfaces available?

Selected models list European-standard interfaces, including TE4Z, TE8K, TZ4Y and KT9X. The exact connector and certification package must be verified for your market.

How do you confirm vehicle range?

We calculate from the actual duty cycle. Payload, speed, grade, temperature, auxiliary loads and battery capacity all affect range, so a single headline figure is not enough.

What information should I send for a quotation?

Please send your country, required quantity, application, payload or GCW, daily distance, road conditions and available charging standard.
